title: Achomi language
description: Iranian language spoken in the south of Iran
extract: Achomi, also known as Larestani, is a Southwestern Iranian language derived from Middle Persian (Parsig) and spoken by the Achomi people in southern Fars and western Hormozgan and by significant numbers of Ajam citizens in the UAE, Bahrain, Kuwait, and other neighbouring countries.
